verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Token2 keys work over NFC, since fido2-manage manages FIDO2.1 devices over USB or NFC. Token2 also ships an open-source mobile companion app for configuring and managing FIDO2 keys on Android and iOS, which implies the keys can talk to phones. However, no evidence explicitly documents tapping the key on a phone to authenticate via WebAuthn in mobile browsers or apps; the cited NFC and mobile material covers key management only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of NFC tap-to-authenticate in mobile browsers/apps, iOS/Android compatibility details for authentication, independent hands-on corroboration.
